That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Decade-long claim files and reinsurance treaties create deep harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure; cryptographic estates are undocumented.

FNOL packets, medical reports, repair estimates and police files arrive as unstructured documents; manual triage queues claims for days before an adjuster sees them. Leakage and customer patience both bleed in the queue.

GLM-based pricing, telematics factors and external data enrichment multiply model complexity faster than validation capacity. Filings get challenged; model risk documentation is reconstructed under exam pressure.

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. Weeks 1–2 are measurement only: we lock the current metric with your team and both sides sign it before a line of build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a named control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 turn what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, then report the measured delta against the baseline. A missed gate means a documented stop-or-redirect decision, not a quiet extension.
